ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Role in Hindering Fraud Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations that the Trump administration has hindered fraud investigations in Minnesota and other states.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential obstruction of justice
questions: What evidence is there that the Trump administration hindered fraud investigations?
How much money is involved in the alleged fraud schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal involving the Trump administration, and could lead to further investigations and prosecutions.
